oraclePolicy.independent: Expected IDs/roles/source rows/unknown fields are independently literal from adopted interface/article, never production frame/fixture import or generated from observed DOM. Freeze future scoped collector details separately from semantic literals.

oraclePolicy.geometry: Record output-to-two-evaluation branches, task-to-independent-check path, model/tool boundary, three tool mappings and checkpoint placement in same coordinate system. oraclePolicy.unknowns: Scores, gain, latency, cost, success, decision, sample sufficiency, ranking and tool correctness remain null/unmeasured. No generated output example, correct-answer mark, fake success, completed measurement/date or automatic adoption recommendation. Source10–20 trial guidance and illustrative counts/phase/geometry are not measured outputs.
oraclePolicy.model: Deterministic pure shared phase clamp/rounding; stable IDs, fresh nested arrays, strict plain options and valid enums; invalid phase/options rejected. No API/network/random/timer. Stored options affect only their adopted effective stages.

visibleByStage: S0: one schematic output branches into separate fluency and requirement-accuracy evaluation fields. Exactly one unmeasured field in each side, not two labels in one box. Dependence on model/language/input/task remains visible; natural output does not imply requirement correctness.

S1: default text row before any selector operation already shows separate unmeasured fluency/accuracy, trend-not-guarantee, independent-verification-required and task→verification relationship. All6 choices map to exact original table row/short label/trend. Preserve training-data-cause uncertainty, weak≠impossible, and need to check meaning accuracy for text strengths. No added row-specific verification example or numerical capability result.

S2: all3 tool mappings and all3 check points visible at once. Model judgment versus external deterministic execution is clear, while selection/arguments/result interpretation can still be wrong. Tool access does not imply whole-Agent correctness or quality gain. A shared set of3 checkpoints is allowed; do not require invented3-per-lane replicas.

S3: date/model/method are visibly unrecorded placeholders. Benchmark and real-case contexts remain separate, with harness/contamination/saturation cautions. Reasoning effort is an evaluation axis of quality/latency/cost, not a measured curve or optimal setting. Visible reevaluation return path when model/conditions change.

S4: all4 source steps in source order, under every focus. Representative difficult real cases and failure cost plus detection/recovery remain visible.10–20 is trial guidance from source, not required test count, sufficient sample, pass threshold/confidence guarantee. No automatic adopt/deploy decision.
geometryChecks: output-current reaches fluency-review and accuracy-review separately; no path or pass icon infers accuracy from fluency.
AtS1 current task has a visible independent verification path, including default text without user selection. Both score/status fields remain inside their respective evaluation boxes.

Each S2 source task maps to the correct external tool endpoint across a clearly labeled model/execution boundary. Shared checkpoints must visibly apply to the tool path, not be unrelated text at page bottom.

Benchmark-context and real-case-context are distinct boxes; no automatic score/ranking transfer to current-task adoption. Re-evaluation path returns to assessment/conditions instead of an unverified success node.
S4 four ordered step cards stay in view; focus changes visual emphasis only.10–20 belongs to real-case guidance, no pass/threshold geometry or arrow to automatic acceptance.
